ns2:section.sectionText: Application of Derivative Strategies is designed to build upon the basic options knowledge you will have gained in FIN 300 and /or 412. You may also have acquired this knowledge in the Options Bootcamp in the MIL. We will start slowly by discussing some simple trading strategies that are used by institutional and retail accounts alike. We will move from there to discuss volatility trading looking not only at the CBOE VIX product but also at OTC variance swaps. Finally, by the end of the semester, we will be discussing the most topical options and derivatives structures such as risk parity, risk premia capture, alternative risk premia and volatility targeting.
